items.name: utils
items.description: cn() class-name merge helper used by every component in the registry.

items.name: button
items.description: Button with 9 variants (primary/secondary/accent/glow/soft/outline/ghost/link/destructive) and 8 sizes (xs-xl plus 3 icon sizes) via class-variance-authority, left/right icon slots, a non-reflowing loading state, and asChild composition via Radix Slot.

items.name: card
items.description: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter.

items.name: badge
items.description: Badge with variant props via class-variance-authority.

items.name: input
items.description: Styled text input wrapping the native <input> element.

items.name: command
items.description: A ⌘K command palette (Command, CommandDialog, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandShortcut) built on cmdk, with its own dialog chrome so it doesn't require a separate Dialog primitive.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Styled multi-line text input wrapping the native <textarea> element.

items.name: switch
items.description: Toggle switch built on Radix Switch, with a thumb that stays legible against both checked and unchecked track colors in either theme.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Tooltip, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent built on Radix Tooltip.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent built on Radix Tabs, styled as a pill-segmented control.

items.name: select
items.description: Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectValue, SelectGroup built on Radix Select.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogClose built on Radix Dialog.

items.name: alert
items.description: Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription with default/destructive variants via class-variance-authority.

items.name: avatar
items.description: Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback built on Radix Avatar.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Checkbox built on Radix Checkbox.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem built on Radix Radio Group.

items.name: separator
items.description: Separator (horizontal or vertical divider) built on Radix Separator.

items.name: progress
items.description: Progress bar built on Radix Progress.

items.name: accordion
items.description: Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent built on Radix Accordion. Needs two keyframes + theme tokens in your global CSS for the expand/collapse animation (accordion-down/accordion-up, animating to/from Radix's --radix-accordion-content-height) — see design.dhruvchoudhary.com's own apps/site/app/globals.css for the Tailwind v4 --animate-* block to copy.

items.name: popover
items.description: Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverAnchor built on Radix Popover.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut built on Radix Dropdown Menu.

items.name: table
items.description: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption -- styled native <table> elements, no primitive dependency.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder for content that hasn't loaded yet.

items.name: empty-state
items.description: The "no rows yet" / "no results" state -- a dashed placeholder with an icon, title, description, and optional action.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator, BreadcrumbEllipsis -- plain semantic nav/ol markup, no primitive library dependency.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, PaginationEllipsis -- built on Button's own variants, no primitive library dependency.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel -- built on Radix Alert Dialog. Distinct from Dialog: forces an explicit confirm/cancel choice, can't be dismissed by clicking outside, for destructive actions.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent (side: top/right/bottom/left), SheetHeader, SheetFooter, SheetTitle, SheetDescription -- built on Radix Dialog (no new primitive dependency), edge-anchored instead of centered.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Combobox -- a searchable select, composed from Popover + Command + Button (no new primitive dependency). Controlled: options/value/onValueChange.

items.name: toast
items.description: Toast, ToastProvider, ToastViewport, ToastTitle, ToastDescription, ToastClose, ToastAction (toast.tsx) + an imperative toast() API (use-toast.ts) + a <Toaster /> to mount once near the app root (toaster.tsx). Built on Radix Toast.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem -- a segmented control, built on Radix Toggle Group. type="single" or "multiple" selection.

items.name: slider
items.description: Slider -- built on Radix Slider. One Thumb per value in the value/defaultValue array, so the same component covers both single-handle and range sliders.

items.name: recipe-auth-form
items.description: Recipe -- a real sign-in form composed from Card + Input + Checkbox + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:auth-form`.

items.name: recipe-settings-panel
items.description: Recipe -- a preferences panel composed from Card + Switch + Select + Separator + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:settings-panel`.

items.name: recipe-pricing-tiers
items.description: Recipe -- a 3-tier pricing layout composed from Card + Badge + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:pricing-tiers`.

items.name: recipe-empty-state-cta
items.description: Recipe -- a "no projects yet" panel composed from EmptyState + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:empty-state-cta`.

items.name: recipe-billing-summary
items.description: Recipe -- a plan/usage summary composed from Card + Badge + Progress + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:billing-summary`.

items.name: recipe-team-members
items.description: Recipe -- a team members table with per-row role badge and actions menu, composed from Table + Avatar + Badge + DropdownMenu + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:team-members`.

items.name: recipe-notification-list
items.description: Recipe -- an unread-count notification feed composed from Card + Avatar + Badge. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:notification-list`.

items.name: recipe-onboarding-checklist
items.description: Recipe -- a step checklist with progress, composed from Card + Progress + Checkbox. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:onboarding-checklist`.
